title: Liquidations
description: Forced closes of leveraged positions on this venue in the last minute. Clusters of them push the price one way and often mark the end of a move.

clustering_state.label: Cluster state
clustering_state.description: Quiet, elevated or cascading, from how bunched recent liquidations are. Cascading means one forced close is triggering the next.

notional_usd_60s.label: Liquidated 60s
notional_usd_60s.description: Dollars of positions force-closed in the last minute. Big numbers mean leverage is being flushed.

side_skew_60s.label: Side skew 60s
side_skew_60s.description: Longs liquidated minus shorts over the total, from minus one to plus one. Positive means longs are the ones being flushed.

count_60s.label: Count 60s
count_60s.description: How many liquidations printed in the last minute. Many small ones read differently from one large one.
